title: Audit conditioned timescape supernova evidence on identical event rows
faithful_claim: Seifert et al. report a timescape preference in a revised Pantheon+ evidence calculation that fixes SALT2 x1,c. Test the statistical and selection sensitivity of this exact comparison, preserving its shared-data ancestry and source geometry.

equations.definitions: Magnitudes are dimensionless logarithmic flux units, d_L is luminosity distance in Mpc; alpha*x1 and beta*c are magnitude corrections. H0 and common absolute-magnitude normalization are degenerate without external calibration.
equations.domain: Same declared selected Pantheon+ rows; distance function belongs to the respective model.

equations.locator: Eq.(5), PDFp3, with code-resolved commonM in pinned bayesian_nongauss.py:RES/COV
equations.definitions: Sigma_d is3N-by3N covariance of interleaved(m_B_star,x1,c) summaries, not just released N-dimensional corrected-distance covariance. Common Mbar_B is supported by inspected code; per-event M_B,i in printed residual remains a source notation inconsistency.
equations.domain: Fixed SALT2 estimate conditioning; exact covariance construction and cross-event lineage must be restored.

equations.locator: Eq.(5), PDFp3, reviewer normalization repair; pinned code m2loglike implements3N
equations.definitions: Printed prefactor has3/2 rather than3N/2; the displayed expression here is explicitly reviewer-repaired. Code supports it for its selected path.
equations.domain: Normalized3N Gaussian under the stated covariance; does not attest statistical appropriateness of data-conditioned delta priors.

equations.expression: ln B=ln Z_TS-ln Z_flat-LambdaCDM; Z_model=integral L(theta)*pi(theta) dtheta
equations.definitions: Positive lnB favors timescape. pi must be a proper prior in a declared measure; evidence changes if finite nuisance or cosmological priors change.
equations.domain: Only the two specified models on identical selected rows; no comparison of absolute evidence across differently selected datasets.

assumptions: Retain the source timescape dressed distance and distinct flat LambdaCDM comparison; verify the tracker mapping and spline construction before any numerical use.
Freeze identical input row identities/order, covariance submatrix and redshift-frame transformation within each paired comparison. Multiple light curves for one SN remain linked observations.
Use the source fixed-x1,c conditional calculation as a reproduction target, then a separately declared uncertainty/selection alternative; neither is presumed scientifically correct.
Treat the grid of nested redshift cuts as correlated sensitivity analyses, not independent detections or a data-independent selection of a homogeneity scale.

minimal_test.question: Does the reported preference survive a faithful paired input/likelihood audit and explicitly declared changes in fixed-estimate conditioning, nuisance priors and redshift selection?
observables: Paired lnB with sampler uncertainty for each preregistered identical event-row selection.
Nuisance/magnitude residual changes, unique-event versus light-curve-row counts, covariance dimensions/order/positive-definiteness and sensitivity to common normalization.
Comparison of fixed-estimate likelihood and a separately specified error/selection treatment on matching rows; any population or survey weighting choices declared before results.

paper_reported.sampler: n_live800,tolerance1e-3; nine-parameter prose conflicts with five-parameter method

inspected_code_only.cut_comparison: sort_and_cut retains z>=zmin; paper excludes z<=zmin. Boundary rows must be checked.

parameter_choices.adoption_reason: Source targets only, not accepted runnable parameters; exact published-run revision/data/configuration unknown.

minimal_test.scope: Start with input identity and symbolic/normalization/parameter bookkeeping. Numerical evidence integration belongs to a later accepted consumer packet. A smaller paired residual/score audit can detect row/covariance/offset mistakes but cannot reproduce Bayesian evidence.

simplifications: No full raw-photometry light-curve retraining or complete survey selection/population likelihood is supplied here.
An averaged dressed distance test does not predict local direction-dependent wall/void expansion or establish the physical cause of low-z residuals.
No absolute H0 measurement, joint BAO/CMB inference, early-universe closure or proof of timescape cosmology.
data_dependencies: Exact P+1690 and P+580 inputs/covariance linked by the paper to DOI10.5281/zenodo.12729746; release/version/bytes and event mapping not audited in this review.
SALT2 fitted summaries and calibration FITRES lineage; full covariance construction and duplicate-observation treatment unresolved.
Source CMB boost without peculiar-velocity corrections, omitted cosmology-dependent bias corrections, host-step test and redshift cuts must remain explicit.
Same observations/covariance ancestry with Lane et al.; cross-analysis dependence unquantified. No multiplied independent-evidence claim.
unknowns: Attested exact published-run source, input, spline, sampler/configuration and output pins.
Complete covariance construction, unique-event/row identity and selection/calibration ancestry.
Intended normalization and statistical meaning after conditioning on measured x1,c; effect of latent-variable/selection alternatives.
Proper variance-versus-standard-deviation prior and nuisance measure intended for published run; exact equality-cut behavior.
Independent source verification of tracker mapping, interpolation accuracy and valid domain.
verification_gates: Bind immutable full source/data/covariance/configuration/output manifests before reproduction; static code presence is insufficient.
Verify row/event identities and preserve repeated-light-curve covariance instead of treating1690 as necessarily uniqueSNe.
Derive conditional likelihood and normalize in its actual dimension; keep printed error and reviewer repair distinct. Demonstrate any model-shared constant cancellation algebraically.
Check cosmological and nuisance prior measure including log10variance; translate finiteM prior consistently if fixedH0 changes.
Validate observer distance/redshift conventions, c restoration, small-z behavior, numerical reference and spline errors separately before evidence sampling.
Preregister paired cuts/reductions and uncertainty treatment; carry correlated selections and survey/selection dependence. No invented execution tolerance.
Require consumer implementation/request validation and acceptance at an inspected revision before any authorized numerical work.
falsification: A row/covariance/magnitude/prior mismatch rejects a claimed reproduction. If a declared faithful comparison removes or reverses the reported preference, that conditioned evidence claim is not robust under the tested contract. If the preference survives the specified corrections/alternatives, it weakens those specific artifact explanations; it still does not prove timescape, establish independence or exclude untested systematics.
